issues: Scroll reveals hid sections with opacity:0: the stats, quote, CTA (and categories on the stress brand) rendered as ~1600px of blank page; on mobile the whole lower half was empty
The cart toast was only translated below the viewport, so in full-page captures it hung off the right edge as a cut-off dark pill mid-page
Mobile horizontal overflow: the rotated story backdrop (inset -4% + 4deg) and the story dot stuck out past the 16px gutter
Hero accent highlight was a flat lower-half bar in a lighter weight; with the grey Droogijs accent it read as a redaction strike, not a cheerful marker
Hero stage: the pile only fills the bottom third, and the top 60% was an empty pastel box
Two-product shops (Birth Bear) left half of the 4-column grid empty on both home and catalog, with tiny cards that had no price, just a lonely + button
Catalog bowl was a faint dashed outline with a small icon that did not read as a drop target, and the tray tags looked undersized for a tray 1200px wide
fixed: Reveals are now transform-only (spring lift) so content is always visible; nothing ever renders blank
Toast is hidden with opacity and visibility plus a spring scale-in, so it no longer leaks into captures
Clipped html/main horizontally and pulled in the mobile story backdrop and dot, so the page no longer overflows at 390px
Hero accent words now sit on chunky rounded tinted 'tags' in --ink-soft (primary tint with an inner lip), echoing the physics pills for any brand colour
Added a giant ghost brand wordmark in a primary tint inside the hero stage, so tags tumble in front of it and the stage reads as a set, not a blank box
Adaptive grid: 1–2 products become large landscape cards with a 4:5 tinted photo pad and chunky display names, and 3 products use 3 columns; mobile falls back to the 2-column card
Catalog bowl redesigned as a tinted basin with a breathing icon disc on a card-white circle; tray tags are bigger and chunkier (62px desktop, 50px mobile)
